payload.title: bug(coordination-engine): resolveBindingAuthorization always resolves the oldest unconsumed…
payload.description: bug(coordination-engine): resolveBindingAuthorization always resolves the oldest unconsumed authorization for a (nodeId, operationId, targetActorId) binding, so a fresh correctly-scoped authorization for the same binding is unreachable once a bad/empty-grant one exists and stays unconsumed. Combined with this: closeSessionByQuorum excludes driver-authorized recheck operations from quorum gating by design ('Minimal safety guard, NOT recheck semantics'), so when a first-pass required actor (e.g. red-team-candidate) genuinely fails and is only fixed via a recheck round, that recheck can never satisfy quorum for that actor -- the session can never reach status:completed through any supported door (partialPolicy can only be declared at session open, before the failure is known; actor-replaced would duplicate already-done recheck work). Observed live: 1) grantedContextRefs-omission bug hit directly while driving code-implementation-track-policy--p01 (fgos-plan-loop), workaround was a context-free operation step to consume the stale authorization, costing 2 extra rounds and nearly exhausting aggregateBounds.maxRounds; 2) the permanently-unclosable-session bug was previously observed on a real fgos-code-panel session (code-panel--r2-p3-p4-frame-codec-supervisor, host-invocation R2 external process provider preview) where red-team-candidate's real HIGH finding was fixed via 3 fix rounds but the session could never close. Evidence: src/runner/coordination/session-engine.mjs resolveBindingAuthorization/bindingAuthorizations (~1130-1197), the driver-authorized dispatch gate (~2470-2620), actorGatingOperationIds (~1409-1475), closeSessionByQuorum (~3582+). Fix scope: engine-only (src/runner/coordination/session-engine.mjs); explicitly out of scope for code-implementation-track-policy per that track's own plan.md and its originating instructions (no CoordinationSession/FlowDefinition/engine runtime changes).
